Journals Contact Us Home » 30 Years of Connecting South African Libraries to the World 30 Years of Connecting South African Libraries to the World Aug 5, 2026 | Articles 30 Years of Connecting South African Libraries to the World A partnership that has helped shape the modern South African library landscape Three Decades of Collaboration For 30 years, Sabinet has partnered with OCLC to help South African libraries connect to global library networks, adopt international standards and improve access to knowledge. Through shared cataloguing, resource sharing and cloud-based library management services, the partnership has supported libraries as they modernised services, improved efficiencies and expanded access to information for researchers, students and communities. Impact on South African Libraries Connected local collections to the world’s largest bibliographic network. Enabled shared cataloguing and resource sharing across institutions. Improved discoverability and visibility of South African library collections. Supported digital transformation through cloud-based library management services. Delivered local implementation, training and support for South African libraries. Helped libraries improve efficiency, reduce duplication and realise cost savings through shared services and collaborative approaches. Partnership in Numbers A Partnership Through Time Year Milestone 1995 Partnership established 1999 WorldCat services introduced 2006 South African cataloguing integrated into WorldCat 2013 WMS introduced in South Africa 2026 Celebrating 30 years 30 Years of Connecting Collections, People and Knowledge For three decades, Sabinet has helped South African libraries connect collections, people and knowledge.
